messages:
Evelyn (CSM): Hi team — kicking off Solstice onboarding. Primary 30-day objectives: API integration on core endpoints, SSO cutover, p95 latency < 250ms for retrieval route, and feature adoption (search route) >= 60% of pilot traffic. Also want a baseline cost estimate per 1k tokens. Who owns what on the Solstice side?
Mauro (Solstice PM): Mauro here. I'll own product acceptance and adoption targets. Our key success signals: 92% intent accuracy on the verification set and search CTR uplift +8pp.
Jia (Solstice Infra): Jia Infra lead. IdP is OIDC: https://sso.solstice.io/. We'll need Redwood outbound IPs and a short DNS maintenance window. Can you share the exact IPs?
Kai (Solutions Eng): Kai here. I'll lead connector, tests, and the bench. Plan: week 0 sandbox + SSO smoke, week 1 connector + e2e smoke, week 2 tuning + bench, week 3 acceptance + enablement. Request: labeled eval (100 examples) by day 7.
Evelyn (CSM): Good plan. Proposed workshops: tech deep-dive (90m), prompt-tuning lab (60m), support triage (30m). Scheduling options next Mon/Wed. We'll run a short weekly pilot survey (3 q) plus emoji quick-checks in this channel for live feedback.
ProvisionerBot: sandbox provisioned: solstice-pilot-sbx v1.4 at 3976543275 (credentials sent via secure email)
Kai (Solutions Eng): Deploy seen. Question: prefix/KV cache ON for bench? My recommendation: OFF through week 2 so we can validate raw correctness, then enable with canary if accepted. Also can add per-route cost tags to logs for spend mapping.
Mauro (Solstice PM): Agreed caching OFF initially. Please record enablement sessions and post to our Confluence space. Also request per-route spend breakdown visible in the console.
Jia (Solstice Infra): We'll open egress for these single IPs once you confirm them. Maintenance window preferred: Sat 02:00-03:00 UTC.
Evelyn (CSM): Action items: 1) Kai -> upload curl examples, bench script, and add route cost tags; 2) Mauro -> deliver labeled eval set + product acceptance doc; 3) Jia -> confirm OIDC metadata + maintenance window; 4) Evelyn -> send allowlist template, set up weekly survey + emoji checklist, and circulate invites. Renewal risk: if search route reaches < 50% adoption of pilot traffic by day 21, flag for AM review.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Curl example and small latency probe script I'm adding to the shared doc:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SBX_KEY" -d '{"input":"Extract total for invoice 789"}' https://sbx.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# simple latency probe
for i in {1..40}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $SBX_KEY" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://sbx.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate >/dev/null; done
```
Mauro (Solstice PM): We'll upload the verification set (120 examples) by EOD Thu. Also request a short rollback playbook in case we see a major regression after enabling caching.
Kai (Solutions Eng): I'll add a rollback plan to the runbook (toggle cache, switch to smaller model, route fallback) and post it.
Evelyn (CSM): Perfect — I'll send calendar invites and the survey link. First check-in scheduled for day7 bench results. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
